payout_quote: Become a member today and get $200!*
steps: Join Notre Dame Federal Credit Union and open a new checking account (complete the Offer Card or online form to receive the offer)

Have an electronic direct deposit of at least $200 made to your Notre Dame FCU checking account - must be payroll, pension, or government benefits (e.g. Social Security) from your employer or the government
Keep the account open; the $200 bonus is awarded the first week of the month following 30 days of completing requirements
catches: Narrow membership field: open to those affiliated with University of Notre Dame, Saint Mary's College, Holy Cross College, St. Patrick Catholic Community, St. Thomas the Apostle Catholic Church, Granger Community Church, and employees of 800+ area organizations
Direct deposit must be at least $200 and must be payroll, pension, or government benefits from employer/government - general ACH transfers may not qualify
Offer Card or online form must be completed to receive the offer - joining without the offer form may miss the bonus
If the checking account is closed within six months after the bonus, the bonus amount will be deducted at closing
Bonus awarded the first week of the month following 30 days of completing requirements - not immediate
Bonus reported as interest on IRS Form 1099-INT (taxable)
Offer may change at any time
biggest_catch: Membership is limited to people affiliated with Notre Dame-affiliated schools, churches, or select employer groups, and closing the account within six months of the bonus means the $200 is clawed back.
eligibility: New members affiliated with University of Notre Dame, Saint Mary's College, Holy Cross College, St. Patrick Catholic Community, St. Thomas the Apostle Catholic Church, Granger Community Church, or employees of 800+ area organizations.
timing: Bonus awarded the first week of the month following 30 days of completing the $200 direct deposit requirement.
weasel_words: Offer may change at any time
